text:
Eve (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands Q&A thread — quick recap from the roadmap segment: focus on pipeline health, partner-led motions, and GTM enablement. Drop questions and action items below.
Marco (VP Sales): Two quick asks — 1) what's our definition of 'sales-ready' partner lead, 2) can we get a weekly snapshot of committed pipeline by segment?
Priya (Head of Partnerships): For (1) we use >$50k TCV, intro from partner, and AE engagement within 72h. Happy to share the checklist.
Luis (AE): Can we get that checklist in Notion? My partner reps keep asking where to find it.
Priya (Head of Partnerships): Will post later today. Also note: partner-led closed-won attribution is being added to SFDC via the "Partner Source" field.
Sam (Product): On roadmap — partner portal (alpha) targeted for end of Q2. Question: do partners need programmatic webhooks or just UI access first?
Jules (Solutions Eng): Webhooks will unblock demo automation for a few ISV partners. Recommend both, but alpha can ship UI-only to start.
Nina (Growth): From a demand angle, can we co-fund a joint webinar series with top 5 partners next quarter? Budget question below.
Zoe (Finance): We can allocate a small demand fund for partner co-marketing (up to $25k per quarter), subject to performance KPIs.
Marco (VP Sales): Re: pipeline snapshot — Alex, can productize a lightweight CSV export from SFDC with fields: acct, opportunity, ARR, stage, partner?
Alex (PM): Yep. I'll scope it and aim for a first pass this week. Will add a checkbox to include "Partner Source" field.
Luis (AE): Also need clear handoff protocol for partner-introduced leads — currently a few are sitting in unassigned queues.
Priya (Head of Partnerships): We're updating the intake flow to auto-assign to the AE owner within 24h. ETA: two weeks.
Eve (CEO): High-level ask to leadership: what's the threshold to flip a customer conversation from Hosted-focused to Dedicated/Private? We need clearer signals for AEs.
Sam (Product): Good call — I'd propose thresholds: >$300k ARR, compliance req (SOC2+ + region isolation), or sustained token volume >200M/month. Thoughts?
Marco (VP Sales): Those thresholds are reasonable. We should also consider strategic logos where we accept lower ARR if strategic.
Zoe (Finance): Agree on thresholds but flag that Dedicated has different cost structure — we'll publish a margin model per deployment type.
Nina (Growth): Can we get one-pager sales collateral summarizing thresholds and buyer objections for Dedicated vs Hosted? I can run copy once product signs off.
Sam (Product): I'll draft the one-pager and share a Google doc by Thursday.
Jules (Solutions Eng): For early partner pilots, recommend we offer a pre-configured Dedicated trial environment to accelerate PoCs — reduces friction.
Priya (Head of Partnerships): Noted. We'll include that as an opt-in in the partner program charter.
DeployBot: deploy:all-hands/recap-pdf uploaded — https://files.redwood.internal/allhands/2026-q1-gTM-recap.pdf
Eve (CEO): Thanks DeployBot. Final: please add clear owners to the action items below and react with :white_check_mark: when you take them.
Marco (VP Sales): Taking: weekly pipeline snapshot (I'll own delivery cadence). :white_check_mark:
Alex (PM): Taking: SFDC CSV export + include Partner Source. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Head of Partnerships): Taking: partner checklist + intake flow update. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Product): Taking: Dedicated thresholds doc + one-pager. :white_check_mark:
Zoe (Finance): Taking: margin model for Dedicated vs Hosted. :white_check_mark:
Nina (Growth): Taking: partner webinar biz case and co-fund proposal. :white_check_mark:
Luis (AE): I'll triage unassigned partner leads this afternoon. :white_check_mark:
Jules (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the pre-configured Dedicated trial playbook. :white_check_mark:
Eve (CEO): Great — we'll review progress in Monday's GTM sync. If anyone else has questions, drop them here. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
